Engineering Methodology

A systematic approach to building resilient, memory-bounded and production-hardened mobile apps.

01

Constraint & Threat Modeling

I set hard limits first, like a 1.2 GB RAM budget, and design apps that work fully offline and keep user data private.

02

Decoupled Architecture & State

I use strict BLoC / Cubit state boundaries, keep background work off the main UI thread, and build native JNI platform channels.

03

Native Engineering & Storage Layers

I cross-compile local C++ inference engines (llama.cpp), build SQLite WAL and FTS5 indexes, and craft Jetpack Compose and Flutter UIs.

04

Bytecode Hardening & Matrix Builds

I enforce ProGuard / R8 obfuscation, resolve MultiDex keep rules, build ABI split binaries and set up reboot-safe exact alarms.

Core competencies

Edge-AI & Embedded ML

Cross-compiling llama.cpp, GGUF 4-bit quantization and JNI to run small language models on the phone.

Polyglot Mobile Development

Flutter (Dart 3) and native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) with BLoC and Cubit patterns.

Database Engines & Local I/O

SQLite and Room with write-ahead logging, FTS5 search and fast JSON / Excel import and export.

DevOps & System Hardening

ProGuard / R8 obfuscation, MultiDex rules, ABI split builds and reboot-safe alarms.
